{{Quote|Die, Outlander!|Dru Velton|<ref name="KOTFE" />}}
'''Dru Velton''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Human" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]] born on [[Zakuul]],<ref name="Zakuul" /> in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="KOTFE" /> who served the [[Eternal Empire]] during their rule of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. A [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], Velton was capable of operating a [[Walker/Legends|walker]] in combat.<ref name="KOTFE" /> In [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> she was deployed against [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] and their allies in the [[Endless Swamp]], and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when her walker was disabled.<ref name="KOTFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dru Velton was added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire|''Knights of the Fallen Empire'']], a [[2015]] Digital Expansion.
